_meta.description: Lat/lon per purok/place for the Hotspot Analysis map (bantay/routes/analytics.py) and for location-name matching on scan (bantay/routes/scan.py _puroks). Every coordinate here MUST fall inside data/anunas_boundary.geojson - tests/test_purok_coordinates.py enforces that. A place without a coordinate still appears in the bar-chart hotspot ranking, just not on the map, so leaving one out is always safer than guessing it.
_meta.default_center_source: Centroid of the Barangay Anunas administrative boundary, OpenStreetMap relation 21180548. Replaces the previous Angeles City city-level placeholder [15.159003, 120.555986]. PhilAtlas gives the barangay center as 15.1559, 120.5551 - within ~450 m, either is defensible.

removed_outside_boundary._why: These plotted OUTSIDE Barangay Anunas - incidents were landing on the map in the wrong barangay. Removed 2026-08-24 rather than replaced: no purok-boundary dataset for Anunas is published anywhere (OSM, PhilAtlas, angelescity.gov.ph), so a substitute would be a guess. Restore each one only from a real survey - a GPS reading at a known landmark in that purok, or the barangay's own purok map.

Purok 3.error: ~15 km NW, in the Sapangbato/Porac uplands

Purok 6.error: east of the boundary, inside Barangay Amsic

ClarkVille Compound.error: 70 m outside the northeast boundary. Sourced from OSM and initially accepted because an Overpass area query returned it for Anunas - Overpass's area matching is more permissive than the boundary polygon. Kept out rather than snapped in: 70 m of "close enough" is how the original bad coordinates got here.

Savannah Green Plains.error: 366 m outside the southern boundary - in the neighbouring barangay. Same Overpass area-matching cause as ClarkVille Compound.

low_precision._why: Inside the boundary but rounded to 2 decimals (~1 km). Anunas is only 1.9 km north-south, so this is ~50% of the barangay's height - fine for a rough pin, too coarse for purok-level hotspot analysis. Re-survey.

_meta.source: OpenStreetMap relation 21180548 (ODbL) via Overpass `out geom`, retrieved 2026-08-24; PhilAtlas for the barangay-center cross-check. Every entry was point-in-polygon tested against the boundary, which rejected 6 of the 12 candidates - including 2 that Overpass itself had returned as being inside.

_meta.aliases_why: `aliases` maps a spelling variant of a place to its canonical name, so analytics counts one place once (bantay/normalize.py canonical_location). Matching ignores case, punctuation, house numbers and St/Street-style abbreviations, and an alias also matches inside a longer address. A null target means the text names no place inside the barangay (exact match only) and the record counts as Unknown. Add a street-to-place alias only when barangay staff confirm it, then re-run tools/migrate_location.py.
